rule: latent B0: z_new = z_own + damping * (mean z(ref cells of the category) - mean z(start cells of the category)) for B0's moved categories, z the encoder means of row E14's count model fitted once per fold on the start and reference stages; decoded: NB counts at the decoded rate of z_new and the real cell's own library, log1p CP10k with the counts outside the modelled genes; ratio: the real cell's counts times decoded-mean(z_new) / decoded-mean(z_own) via apply_factors (expected depth kept, zeros kept, held-flat genes 1), log factor clipped at +-log 3

latent B0: z_new = z_own + damping * (mean z(ref cells of the category) - mean z(start cells of the category)) for B0's moved categories, z the encoder means of row E14's count model fitted once per fold on the start and reference stages; decoded: NB counts at the decoded rate of z_new and the real cell's own library, log1p CP10k with the counts outside the modelled genes; ratio: the real cell's counts times decoded-mean(z_new) / decoded-mean(z_own) via apply_factors (expected depth kept, zeros kept, held-flat genes 1), log factor clipped at +-log 3

latent flow: z_new = z(tau), dz/dt = v(z, lineage), z(0) = z_own, tau = B0_DAMPING x the last gap in days, v one MLP fitted by flow matching on entropic-OT pairs within each lineage between every two consecutive input stages (velocity (z_j - z_i) / gap, weights proportional to the gap per lineage), then the ratio arm's realisation and stream
